inventory: All16 executed closed rows in the original32-row HOLD report, in original order; retain16 source-blocked rows as not executed. No filtering by success, submission or condition.
sources: Episode manifest and its archived end state and immutable file versions
Already bound actual selected-request JSON files
no_new_execution: No changes to old F, reports, guards or runtime
work_chain: Actual original issue visible in a selected input; edits with exact previous/next immutable reference and full files hash; original tests with identical source reference/files hash; first exact actual feedback presentation from the already-bound measurement; same-tree fixed patches and submissions, retaining their original outcomes and rejections.
partner_chain: Separate public patch/message, receiving member's actual public observation, explicit read of peer fixed code and actual feedback presentation, successful integrate/adopt with before/after tree and dependency IDs, receiver tests on the exact imported tree, and fixed delivery ancestry. Visibility alone never proves use. Textual/semantic uptake without an explicit mechanically bound import remains unknown.
repeat_read: Same member, same file path and exact immutable source reference, identical range/search arguments and identical returned text/matches hash. Count second and later actual actions and their own full request-response token charges. Cross-member exact-content overlap is reported separately and not added to same-member repetitions.
repeat_edit: Track actual changed file bytes, no-change edits, repeated same arguments against the same before tree, and returns to an earlier complete files hash. A revert is not automatically waste. Attribute original action's full generation cost only, not hypothetical marginal savings.
fees: Use existing actual per-call reported_usage and charged_tokens bound by the original native accounting/guards; do not add nested costs or assign costs to zero-generation decisions. Report unknowns rather than zero.
decision_boundaries: Passing public tests do not by themselves imply a lawful fixed submission. Subsequent actual opportunities, original fix/submit attempts and exact rejection text are retained. No assertion that larger budget or changed behavior would have succeeded.
uncertainty: Mechanical source/visibility/version chains can be established. Correct problem localization, interpretation of a counterexample, causal use of a message, and causal reasons for work choices require semantic judgment and remain unknown unless specifically supported by cited evidence.
execution: One full16 traversal, four independent CPU readers maximum. Any parser errors are retained; no model/test execution follows. Later prose reads only generated audit artifacts unless a specific evidence gap requires a separately recorded narrow inspection.
schema_preparation_note: A first compact schema probe mistakenly treated all experience payloads as dict and stopped on a public_tools list (AttributeError). The corrected probe filters tool_call before reading action. This happened before the full16 audit; no source or outcome was changed.
new12_selection: This analysis does not select, replace or reorder the predeclared six CAL2 bridge tasks or12 new slots.
